text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: Multiple latency SLO alerts for hosted streaming in eu-west-2. p95 and p99 tails spiking since ~3978879900, streaming stalls and increased TLS handshake latencies observed. Affected routes: /v1/stream/* (eu-west-2), small subset of customers reporting stalls. Paging on-call: @ryan
ryan: ack. looking. any initial graph links?
eng-sre: link: https://grafana.redwood/streams/eu-west-2?panel=tail_latency - p99 jumped from 120ms -> 1.8s at ~3978879950. connection establishment failures increased.
ryan: seeing many TLS handshake timeouts in logs: 
```
2026-10-21T08:19:10Z client=10.20.5.33 route=/v1/stream id=abc123 tls_handshake_ms=1850 upstream_err=timeout
2026-10-21T08:19:11Z client=10.20.5.44 route=/v1/stream id=def456 tls_handshake_ms=2100 upstream_err=timeout
```
ryan: triage plan: check egress NAT saturation, DNS latencies, cross-AZ routing. eng-infra can you confirm NAT ephemeral port usage and any recent host changes?
eng-infra: Confirmed spike in ephemeral port usage on euw2-nat-a. conntrack count for squid-proxy pool approaching limit. Also seeing increased SYN retries to upstream model pods. No config rollouts in the last 30m except a metrics agent update 2h ago.
maria: I'm taking customer-facing comms draft. Which customers impacted? product-support: small set of high-traffic customers in EU (customer ids: C-930, C-114). Errors correlate with long-lived streaming sessions.
devex: quick ask — are we sure this is egress NAT and not internal mesh? I see some DNS >500ms from the worker nodes to resolver 10.10.10.2. sample dig output: 
```
; <<>> DiG 9.16.1 <<>> api.redwood-eu.internal
;; Query time: 522 msec
;; WHEN: Tue Oct 21 08:19:06 2026
```
eng-sre: running tcpdump on nat gateway shows retransmits and some packet loss to 52.12.33.40 (upstream model host). sample: "6 retransmissions, 3 dup acks".
ryan: mitigation idea: 1) fail traffic off euw2-nat-a to euw2-nat-b by adjusting egress steer, 2) scale up NAT nodes + bump conntrack, 3) short-term route traffic to other AZs for streaming routes with minimal client impact. Any objections?
eng-infra: will open egress steering change now. patch command (kf): 
```
kubectl patch configmap egress-steer -n infra -p '{"data":{"priority":"euw2-nat-b,euw2-nat-a"}}'
```
eng-infra: also increasing conntrack sysctl on nat-b to 524288 and rolling it. command: `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=524288`
ryan: doing a hot reroute for streaming route only: updating route table to prefer euw2-nat-b for /v1/stream. Applying now.
deploy-bot: canary change applied to 10% of sessions routed via euw2-nat-b at 3978880045.
eng-sre: initial metrics: p99 down from 1.8s -> 420ms for canary traffic; overall cluster p99 marginally improved. Packet loss on nat-a still high.
maria: draft to customers: "We are investigating increased latency for streaming in EU region. We have applied an egress reroute to reduce TLS handshake failures and are continuing to monitor. Will update in 15 minutes." ping @product-support for signoff. :writing_hand:
product-support: signoff. send.
customer-ops: customer C-930 confirms improved experience after ~2 minutes, reconnects successful.
devex: FYI, collected tcpdump and DNS captures, uploading to incident bucket: s3://redwood-incidents/3978880000/pcap.tar.gz
ryan: monitoring for 15m. if p99 stays under 500ms we'll keep steering and plan a postmortem. Also we should check why nat-a conntrack spiked — any long-lived ports?
eng-infra: found a misbehaving proxy pod in euw2 that kept many ephemeral ports tied (heap growth => leak). We evicted pod and restarted service. heaptrace attached.
eng-sre: after eviction, nat-a conntrack freed up, packet loss dropped, p99 stabilized across region to ~180ms at 3978880110.
maria: handing to @maria for on-call lull/cleanup and postmortem. ryan: passing pager to maria, I'm available on-call fallback. :thumbsup:
maria: acked. I'll start a timeline, collect logs, and coordinate postmortem. immediate actions: 1) keep egress steer in place for 30m 2) run conntrack accounting for 1h 3) gather heap dump and restart history for the misbehaving proxy 4) draft RCA outline.
eng-infra: scheduling a controlled reboot for remaining proxy replicas in euw2 at 3978880200 to prevent recurrence.
incident-bot: incident closed for paging at 3978880120 — mitigations in place, impact reduced. Create postmortem with severity P2 if degradation persists.
ryan: thanks team. I'll add notes to runbook: add alert for ephemeral port percent usage and automatic egress-steer playbook.
maria: noted. creating postmortem ticket: PM-397888. folks, add any additional context and logs to the ticket. :white_check_mark:
